Indexes:
    "tag_data_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (opid)
    "tag_data_objid_index" btree (objid)
    "tag_data_text_idx" gin (tsdata)
    "tag_editing_session_index" btree (editingsession) WHERE editingsession <> '-1'::integer
Check constraints:
    "rev_constraint" CHECK (dlesession > 0 AND fromversion IS NULL AND toversion IS NULL OR (dlesession = 0 OR dlesession = '-1'::integer) AND fromversion IS NOT NULL AND toversion IS NOT NULL)
Triggers:
    object_create BEFORE INSERT ON tag_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE create_object_tag_data()
    object_update BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON tag_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_object_tag_data()
    tsvectorupdate BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON tag_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE tsvector_update_trigger('tsdata', 'pg_catalog.simple', 'name')

### CPM - Table: blobauthkey_data

**Schema Definition:**

```sql
                                                             Table "public.blobauthkey_data"
           Column            |          Type          | Collation | Nullable |              Default               | Storage  | Stats target | Description 
-----------------------------+------------------------+-----------+----------+------------------------------------+----------+--------------+-------------
 objid                       | uuid                   |           | not null |                                    | plain    |              | 
 blobset                     | text                   |           |          |                                    | extended |              | 
 checkpointobjid             | uuid                   |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 dlesession                  | smallint               |           |          | mysessionid()                      | plain    |              | 
 domainid                    | uuid                   |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 folder                      | uuid                   |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 hashstring                  | character varying(255) |           |          |                                    | extended |              | 
 permissionprimitivepresetid | uuid                   |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 readprimitiveid             | uuid                   |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 opid                        | bigint                 |           | not null | nextval('opid_sequence'::regclass) | plain    |              | 
 fromversion                 | integer                |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 toversion                   | integer                |           |          |                                    | plain    |              | 
 editingsession              | smallint               |           |          | '-1'::integer                      | plain    |              | 
 deleted                     | boolean                |           |          | false                              | plain    |              | 
Indexes:
    "blobauthkey_data_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (opid)
    "blobauthkey_data_objid_index" btree (objid)
    "blobauthkey_editing_session_index" btree (editingsession) WHERE editingsession <> '-1'::integer
Check constraints:
    "rev_constraint" CHECK (dlesession > 0 AND fromversion IS NULL AND toversion IS NULL OR (dlesession = 0 OR dlesession = '-1'::integer) AND fromversion IS NOT NULL AND toversion IS NOT NULL)
Triggers:
    object_create BEFORE INSERT ON blobauthkey_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE create_object_blobauthkey_data()
    object_update BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON blobauthkey_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_object_blobauthkey_data()
```

Check constraints:
    "rev_constraint" CHECK (dlesession > 0 AND fromversion IS NULL AND toversion IS NULL OR (dlesession = 0 OR dlesession = '-1'::integer) AND fromversion IS NOT NULL AND toversion IS NOT NULL)

```sql
Indexes:
    "threatpolicy_data_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (opid)
    "threatpolicy_data_objid_index" btree (objid)
    "threatpolicy_editing_session_index" btree (editingsession) WHERE editingsession <> '-1'::integer
Check constraints:
    "rev_constraint" CHECK (dlesession > 0 AND fromversion IS NULL AND toversion IS NULL OR (dlesession = 0 OR dlesession = '-1'::integer) AND fromversion IS NOT NULL AND toversion IS NOT NULL)
Triggers:
    object_create BEFORE INSERT ON threatpolicy_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE create_object_threatpolicy_data()
    object_update BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON threatpolicy_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_object_threatpolicy_data()
```

```sql
    "linktovalidate_filtered_data_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (opid)

    "linktovalidate_filtered_objid_idx" btree (objid)
Check constraints:
    "rev_constraint" CHECK (dlesession > 0 AND fromversion IS NULL AND toversion IS NULL OR (dlesession = 0 OR dlesession = '-1'::integer) AND fromversion IS NOT NULL AND toversion IS NOT NULL)
Triggers:
    object_create BEFORE INSERT ON linktovalidate_filtered_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE create_object_linktovalidate_filtered_data()
    object_update BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON linktovalidate_filtered_data FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_object_linktovalidate_filtered_data()
```
